title: Concept: Set-Cookie Domain ends with a dot
description: The trailing dot comes from a fully-qualified name copied into configuration. Browsers do not normalise it, so the cookie silently stops applying, and the failure looks like a session bug rather than a configuration error.
applicability: Responses that template the cookie domain from a fully-qualified host name.
risk: The cookie is rejected, so the session it carries never reaches the browser on the canonical host.
